data.name: Entropos
data.detailed_description:
Entropos is a team-based tactical online shooter featuring truly brutal combat in a fully destructible world. A massive arsenal of weapons, realistic equipment, and deep authentic customization. Prepare for absolute carnage.

The year is 2027. World War III is just around the corner.

You are a trooper in the largest American private military company ECHELON or in the elite Russian special forces unit Brodeksova Rota. Officially, neither represents its country’s regular armed forces. In practice, they are the means through which two global powers test each other’s resolve, each waiting for the other to show weakness first.

Entropos delivers brutal tactical combat where death comes quickly and every decision carries real weight. Choose from 15 specializations or create your own, coordinate with your squad, your goal through brute force or tactical ingenuity.

In Entropos, victory favors those who adapt to the chaos of war.

Every system inevitably descends into chaos.

In Entropos, chaos is an integral part of the experience. Every action leaves its mark on the game’s highly physical world — from a mug knocked off a table to walls and cover torn apart by explosions. Chaos can overturn your entire strategy, or become a powerful tool in skilled hands.

The environment is not the only thing affected by chaos. Equipment becomes stained with mud and blood, and wounds leave deep scars on the bodies and minds of the troopers.

Customization is a major part of Entropos.

Five classes. Fifteen specializations. One fully customizable Trooper.

Weapons and equipment are recreated with near-encyclopedic accuracy in collaboration with experts and manufacturers, giving players the freedom to fine-tune every aspect of their loadout and authentically adapt their character’s appearance to any mission.

Add Entropos to Wishlist!

The game and the universe are in the process of development. New mechanics, new weapons, new characters and locations all over the world, new story discoveries are waiting ahead!

Regular development updates are posted on Discord and other social media — join the discussions and stay connected!
